questions.scenario: It is a Sunday morning and Papa is reading the local newspaper. What catches your attention?

options.A: Helping Dadi prepare the fresh flower thali for the morning mandir visit before breakfast.
options.B: Flipping to the Panchang section to check the exact sunrise time, tithi, and Rahukal for the day.
options.C: Reading my Zodiac prediction for the week and instantly sharing a screenshot on my WhatsApp status.
options.D: Wondering how much money the newspaper makes from all those full-page gemstone and astrology ads.

questions.scenario: Mummy strictly tells you to wear a yellow shirt today because 'It's Thursday and your board exams are near'. How do you react?

options.A: I quickly wear yellow and let her put a small haldi/kesar tilak on my forehead before leaving, just to be safe.
options.B: I mentally calculate if Jupiter (Guru) is actually placed beneficially in my birth chart before agreeing.
options.C: I style the yellow shirt perfectly with matching accessories so my exam day 'OOTD' looks incredibly aesthetic.
options.D: I joke with her that if yellow shirts guaranteed 95%, the school uniform business would be a monopoly.

questions.scenario: You have a massive crush on someone in your tuition class. How do you investigate your compatibility?

options.A: I secretly pray at the local Hanuman temple that we end up in the same school section next year.
options.B: I try to cleverly extract their exact time and city of birth so I can run a proper Kundali matching on my phone.
options.C: I send them highly relatable 'Leo and Scorpio energy' reels on Instagram to drop massive hints.
options.D: I think about how dating apps should just integrate an automatic Kundali matcher to save everyone's time.

questions.scenario: It's Diwali night. The entire house is lit up with diyas. What is your main responsibility?

options.A: Sitting right next to Papa, actively reciting the Laxmi Puja mantras and offering flowers to the idols.
options.B: Reminding everyone that the exact 'Shubh Muhurat' (auspicious time) ends at 7:14 PM, so we must hurry.
options.C: Making an elaborate, colorful Rangoli at the entrance and forcing everyone to pose for aesthetic family pictures.
options.D: Distributing the sweets boxes to the neighbors and managing the overall budget for the firecrackers.

questions.scenario: A relative comes over for tea and starts gossiping about a serious 'Manglik Dosha' in someone's marriage. What are you doing?

options.A: I respectfully bring the chai and biscuits, listening quietly while the elder pandit ji discusses traditional remedies.
options.B: I whip out my phone, open an astrology app, and try to visualize which house Mars is sitting in to cause this.
options.C: I sit there imagining how dramatic and entertaining this would look as a plot twist in a Bollywood daily soap.
options.D: I think about how much money wedding planners and pandits make from organizing these specialized 'Dosha-cutting' pujas.

questions.scenario: You are on a family vacation and visit a massive, ancient historical temple. What fascinates you the most?

options.A: Enthusiastically joining the massive aarti, ringing the heavy bells, and getting the red 'kalawa' tied on my wrist.
options.B: Observing how the ancient architecture perfectly aligns with the North Star and the sun's equinoxes.
options.C: Clicking highly aesthetic, moody pictures of the diyas and stone carvings for my Instagram photo dump.
options.D: Noticing the huge crowd and mentally calculating the temple's daily donation revenue and crowd-management efficiency.

questions.scenario: Your best friend is going through a terrible breakup and feels like they have 'bad luck'. How do you help?

options.A: I take them to the local temple on a Tuesday evening to eat boondi prasad and feel a sense of peace.
options.B: I casually ask them if they are going through their 'Sade Sati' (Saturn return) phase and check their transits.
options.C: I make a personalized Spotify playlist, buy them crystals, and create a cute mood board to heal their energy.
options.D: I tell them they should start a YouTube channel or podcast about their terrible dates to monetize their heartbreak.

questions.scenario: Your Dadi/Nani gives you a chunky gemstone ring (like a Sapphire or Pearl) to wear for 'good luck in studies'.

options.A: I wear it respectfully, wash it with Gangajal first as instructed, and promise never to take it off.
options.B: I immediately Google what chemical composition the stone has and which specific planet it represents.
options.C: I complain that the chunky silver ring ruins my modern aesthetic and try to wear it hidden on a chain instead.
options.D: I look up the current market value of the gemstone and wonder about the massive profit margins jewelers make.

questions.scenario: Your family is planning to buy a new car. How does the astrology angle come in?

options.A: I make sure I have the lemons and chillies ready to tie on the bumper as soon as the car arrives home.
options.B: I consult the Panchang to ensure we don't accidentally bring the car home during Rahukaal (inauspicious time).
options.C: I convince my parents to buy the car in a 'lucky' color that also happens to look incredibly cool in photos.
options.D: I negotiate hard with the car dealer, ignoring the 'auspicious delivery date' if it means getting a bigger cash discount today.

questions.scenario: You download a popular astrology app (like Astrotalk) just out of curiosity. What grabs your attention first?

options.A: The option to book a live online Puja and get physical prasad delivered directly to your home.
options.B: The highly complex birth charts, transit tracking, and detailed numerical planetary data they provide.
options.C: The beautiful UI, the daily motivational quotes, and the cool animations they use for the Zodiac signs.
options.D: The business model—figuring out how they charge per minute for calls and manage thousands of astrologers on one platform.

Ritual_Guide.title: Temple Astrologer / Ritual Guide
Ritual_Guide.primary_match_text: The Action-Oriented Spiritualist! You love participating in physical rituals, traditions, and hands-on practices.
Ritual_Guide.day_in_the_life: Performing traditional pujas, guiding families through religious ceremonies, offering practical spiritual remedies, and keeping ancient traditions alive on the ground.
Ritual_Guide.roadmap: 11th/12th (Arts/Humanities) -> BA in Sanskrit or Hindu Studies -> Specialization in Karamkand (Rituals) -> Traditional Certifications like Jyotish Visharad.

Kundali_Analyst.title: Kundali / Jyotish Analyst
Kundali_Analyst.primary_match_text: The Cosmic Mathematician! You are highly analytical and love diving deep into charts, degrees, and calculations.
Kundali_Analyst.day_in_the_life: Analyzing complex birth charts (Kundalis), calculating planetary transits, and predicting life events using strict Vedic mathematics, logic, and ancient texts.
Kundali_Analyst.roadmap: 11th/12th (Any Stream, Science/Maths is helpful) -> BA/BSc in Astrology or Mathematics -> Master's (MA in Jyotish) -> Advanced research in Vedic Astrology from institutes like BHU.

Astro_Content_Creator.title: Horoscope Content Creator
Astro_Content_Creator.primary_match_text: The Mystical Trendsetter! You are highly creative and know exactly how to make ancient knowledge look cool and relatable today.
Astro_Content_Creator.day_in_the_life: Designing beautiful Zodiac infographics, recording engaging Instagram Reels about moon signs, and making viral astrology memes that thousands of teenagers share.
Astro_Content_Creator.alternative_match_text: Social Media Manager, Digital Artist, Tarot Reader
Astro_Content_Creator.roadmap: 11th/12th (Any Stream) -> BA in Mass Communication, Design, or Fine Arts -> Short courses in Astrology/Tarot combined with Digital Marketing & Video Editing skills.

Astro_Tech_Founder.title: Astro-Tech Entrepreneur
Astro_Tech_Founder.primary_match_text: The Visionary Leader! You see the big picture and understand how to turn traditional beliefs into a massive, modern digital business.
Astro_Tech_Founder.day_in_the_life: Running a massive astrology app, managing a huge team of tech developers and astrologers, and scaling your brand to reach millions of users worldwide.
Astro_Tech_Founder.alternative_match_text: Startup Founder, App Developer, Business Consultant
Astro_Tech_Founder.roadmap: 11th/12th (Commerce/Science) -> BBA or B.Tech -> MBA from a top B-School -> Building tech startups in the spiritual, wellness, or astrology space.
